tests: 1. registers external capabilities with structured schemas, risk tiers, and permissions
2. retrieves registered capabilities by ID and supports filtering by type and availability
3. validates request parameters against capability input schema
4. rejects requests targeting non-existent or unregistered capabilities
5. enforces default DENY and rejects execution when required permissions are missing
6. correctly classifies operational risk levels (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)
7. executes LOW-risk read operations without requiring explicit approval
8. halts HIGH-risk actions in REQUIRES_APPROVAL status when operator approval is absent
9. strictly requires human authorization for CRITICAL actions and rejects autonomous approval
10. dispatches valid, authorized actions end-to-end through the Action Bus
11. verifies Action Bus interacts solely via CapabilityAdapter without knowledge of implementation details
12. normalizes adapter outputs into standard ActionResult contracts
13. enforces idempotency: repeated requests with identical key return cached result without duplicate execution
14. prevents duplicate side-effects for GitHub issue creation with identical idempotency key
15. classifies failures into retryable (TRANSIENT, RATE_LIMIT, TIMEOUT) and non-retryable categories
16. strictly respects capability retry limits and does not loop infinitely
17. enforces execution timeout and terminates stalled adapter operations
18. supports explicit cancellation of in-flight operations
19. integrates with Stage 10 resource limits and operational constraints
20. strictly prevents path traversal and restricts file operations to declared sandbox paths
21. restricts HTTP requests to declared allowlisted domains
22. restricts GitHub operations to declared authorized repositories
23. rejects payloads exceeding declared size limits
24. strictly strips API keys, tokens, and authorization headers from persisted action records
25. creates an immutable, sanitized ActionAuditRecord for every action dispatch
26. durably persists ActionRequests, ActionResults, and audit records into ExecutionPersistence
27. restores action audit state and respects recovery policies on envelope reload
28. classifies unverified external outcomes as STATE_UNKNOWN
29. queries external capabilities to reconcile state and avoids duplicate writes
30. emits ACTION_RESULT_MEMORY_EVENT on successful execution
31. creates ACTION nodes and EXECUTED_ACTION edges in Stage 13 Strategic Knowledge Graph
32. enforces that Stage 14 decision approvals do not bypass Stage 15 Action Bus authorization
33. links ActionRequests and audit records to Stage 12 mission context
34. permits Stage 08 goal orchestrator to delegate external capability actions to Action Bus
35. strictly maintains separation between Stage 07 executionGateway and Stage 15 actionBus
36. verifies Action Bus services make zero direct provider API calls
37. verifies all capabilities run through sandboxed mock adapters with zero live network credentials required
38. verifies stage03 Blender master scene and camera baseline remain completely untouched
39. renders SpatialCommandConsole and verifies Action Bus HUD panels render without 3D draw call overhead
